evidence_quotes.agenda: before I go over with our pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any specific concern or stresser. About the moving process. -- asked late, right before the pricing pitch, after full inventory probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer's response was essentially 'No' -- no real concern raised, full credit applies.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: once we go over the minimum, the time is per rated in fifteen minute increments

top_strength: Clean, efficient studio-apartment call with a well-personalized estimate (accounting for the walk distance on both ends) and a gracious close when the customer declined on price.
coaching_note: The customer passed specifically because of price ('that'll be too much for me') right after the estimate landed -- no rate-lock or explicit ask ever got a chance to land since the SYA fairness-check answer was an immediate no; worth flagging price sensitivity earlier in the call next time.
